column2: LibriVox volunteers bring you 18 recordings of High Flight by John Gillespie Magee Jr.. This was the Weekly Poetry project for November 8, 2026. ------ After discussions with his parents, he decided to go to Canada to join the Royal Canadian Air Force (RCAF), with the intention of learning to fly, and then being sent to Britain.

LibriVox volunteers bring you 13 recordings of Elpsie's Croon by George Francis Dawson. This was the Weekly Poetry project for October 25, 2026. ------ This Halloween Poem is an excerpt from Myra's Well, A Tale of All-Hallow-e'en, by George Francis Dawson (published 1883) Herein we find all the ingredients one would find brewing in a black cauldron. - Summary by David Lawrence
